remarks: 868-870 Boston Post Road is an incredible investment opportunity in a PRIME downtown Darien location with great visibility for any business. The building is steps to Darien train station and walkable to a variety of restaurants and shopping with a private 18-space rear parking lot and adjacent public parking lot. This property is also uniquely zoned for professional/medical or retail use on the first floor. There is also the possibility for redevelopment, keep the first floor professional/office and develop Six (6) One-Bedroom Residential Rental Units above. See attached marketing flyer with updated pro-forma financial projections for this development.
